experiment: EL4 — reduced physics for the stiff zone: 'same distance, same size' shells, gapless, beads shrinking by the same rule
author_rules: R1 same distance -> same size: every bead in one spherical shell has the same size s(r) (radial reduction of the full 3-D physics)
R2 gapless (no voids) inside the stiff zone

R3 beads shrink by the same rule toward the proton: self-similar, s proportional to r (equivalently, every shell holds the same number n of beads, which is also what steady inflow through every shell requires)
R4 at the outer edge beads have the normal size D
corpus_rule: isostatic coordination z = 6 (jamming spine [V]): 4 in-shell neighbours + 1 inward + 1 outward -> square tiling of each shell, n = 4 pi / eps^2 with eps = s/r
derived_before_run: outer radius R = D/eps; 1/alpha = R/(D/4pi) = 4 pi/eps = sqrt(4 pi n). The rules leave ONE number free: beads per shell n.

routes_for_n.N1_consumption: n = nu_p = 3 pi^4 (proton consumption per electron-second)

also_report: number of shells between the proton radius (0.8414 fm) and the stand-off
scoring: HIT if within 1e-3 of 137.036; three routes tried, so one hit is a candidate [H] only
